correctness.rationale: Over F_Q (Q=q^m), every blockwise F_q-support space V_L is an F_Q subspace of dimension s and V_L^perp=V_(L^perp). The dimension formula gives a=dim(C∩V_L), b=dim(C^perp∩V_(L^perp)), a-b=k+s-n=delta. Summing P_a(z)=prod_{j<a}(1+Q^j z)=sum_r Q^{r choose 2}[a choose r]_Q z^r over all support tuples of fixed dimensions, and factoring P_(b+delta)=P_delta P_b(Q^delta z), gives both nonnegative delta branches and the complement-profile identity. Double counting (subcode D, containing support tuple L) gives B_r(C,s)=sum_{t<=s} N_r(C,t) prod_i [n_i-t_i choose s_i-t_i]_q, unitriangular with diagonal one and hence exactly invertible. Independently constructed a nontrivial GF4 code with two length-two blocks and its Euclidean dual, and verified all nine profiles and both signs of delta in arithmetic independent of the package verify.py. Infinite/full arbitrary-code result follows from algebra, not this finite example.

value.rationale: Complete joint-support spectrum for all dimensions of subcodes is a natural higher-order code invariant, and a reversible MacWilliams transform is a substantive classification-like structural identity for arbitrary multiblock codes. The tensor-product geometry and Gaussian inversion are motivated beyond an arbitrary finite test or renamed one-block result.

scientific_limitations: Only finite fields with F_Q-linearity, n_i<=m and ordinary Euclidean dual; not arbitrary additive, nonlinear or Galois-twisted codes.
This is a transform of already known support-profile counts, not a formula using only length and code dimension.
